_meta.description: Verified site interaction protocols. Agents MUST read this before navigating any AI site. If a protocol exists and is not stale (last_verified within 30 days), use it directly — do NOT run snapshot discovery. After successfully interacting with a site, update the protocol entry.
_meta.update_instruction: After a successful send+receive cycle, update the matching site entry: set last_verified to today's date (YYYY-MM-DD), update selectors if they changed, and save this file.

input.notes: @e99 is the 'Chat with ChatGPT' textbox (contenteditable DIV). Refs change between sessions — always snapshot to confirm.

send.notes: @e101 is the 'Send prompt' button. Refs change between sessions — always snapshot to confirm.

input.notes: fill FAILS on DeepSeek — must use native setter via IIFE
input.code_template: (() => { const ta = document.querySelector('textarea'); ta.focus(); const s = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set; s.call(ta, '{{MESSAGE}}'); ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); })()

send.notes: click on submit does not work — dispatch Enter keydown on textarea
Find and click submit button, or dispatch Enter
send.code: (() => { const btn = document.querySelector('button[type="submit"]') || document.querySelector('[aria-label="Send"]'); if (btn) { btn.click(); } else { document.querySelector('[contenteditable]').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key:'Enter',bubbles:true})); } })()

input.notes: Gemini uses Quill editor (div.ql-editor). The old 'rich-textarea' selector does NOT exist. fill works on div.ql-editor in contenteditable mode.

send.code: (() => { const btn = document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Send message"]'); if (btn) { btn.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {bubbles:true,cancelable:true})); return 'ok'; } return 'not found'; })()
send.notes: Plain click() fails — use evaluate to dispatch MouseEvent. Button has class 'mdc-icon-button' and is enabled when input has text.
